title: Case 06: A persistent goal — create a course (Vue 3)
titleZh: 案例06：持久目标创建课程（Vue 3）
summary: The same real course page, plus one goal. The goal has no fields, steps, controller or form tools: it keeps the outcome alive while the agent opens the real create dialog, fills the actual controls, asks for the cover, saves and verifies the catalogue.
summaryZh: 同一张真实课程页面，只多一个目标。目标不包含字段、步骤、控制器或表单工具：它让结果在弹窗关闭后继续存在；助手自己打开新建弹窗、操作真实控件、请用户上传封面、保存并回读课程库。

guide.title: A goal that survives the page
guide.titleZh: 目标在页面变化后仍然存在
intro: The goal is the only thing this case adds to Case 07. It has no fields, steps, controller, form surface or business callbacks. The agent still sees the real page: the create button, every field, the cover handoff and the save action.
That small layer answers four questions the DOM cannot: why the work continues after the modal closes, where the task can be started, how it is cancelled, and when the outcome is actually complete.
introZh: 这个案例相对案例07只多了一个目标。它没有字段、步骤、控制器、表单 surface，也没有业务回调。助手看到的仍然是真实页面：新建按钮、每个字段、封面上传和保存动作。
这一小层回答 DOM 回答不了的四个问题：弹窗关闭后为什么这件事还在继续、任务从哪里开始、怎样取消，以及什么时候才算真正完成。

steps.title: Register the goal, not the workflow
steps.titleZh: 注册目标，而不是工作流
steps.body: This is the whole task integration. `goal` accepts an outcome, boundaries, success criteria and examples. It deliberately rejects field schemas, step controllers and page callbacks.
steps.bodyZh: 这就是任务接入的全部代码。`goal` 只接收结果、边界、成功条件和示例，刻意不接受字段 schema、步骤控制器和页面回调。

steps.title: Land on the catalogue, not an open dialog
steps.titleZh: 先落在课程库，而不是打开的弹窗
steps.body: The page starts with the real `new_course` action visible and the dialog closed. Starting the goal never calls page code; the agent must discover the button and click it.
steps.bodyZh: 页面初始只显示真实的 `new_course` 动作，弹窗是关闭的。启动目标不会调用页面代码；助手必须自己发现并点击新建按钮。

steps.title: Let the real form be the schema
steps.body: Once the dialog opens, the agent operates `course_name`, `course_teacher`, `course_cards`, the star buttons and the text areas. There is no second field list to keep in sync.
steps.bodyZh: 弹窗打开后，助手操作 `course_name`、`course_teacher`、`course_cards`、星级按钮和文本框。没有第二份字段表需要同步。

steps.title: Keep the goal when the dialog closes
steps.titleZh: 弹窗关闭后目标仍然存在
steps.body: Closing the dialog removes the field actions from the DOM, but not the goal. KeepActive is the default for `goal()`, so the agent can continue a conversation, reopen the form or ask the person to upload the cover.
steps.bodyZh: 关闭弹窗会移除字段动作，但不会移除目标。`goal()` 默认 keepActive，因此助手可以继续对话、重新打开表单，或请用户上传封面。

steps.title: Verify through the page, then complete the goal
steps.titleZh: 从页面验证，再完成目标
steps.body: `save_course` declares an `expect` check that reads the catalogue back. Only after that evidence exists should the agent call the task completion tool; completion closes the goal and never writes business data.
steps.bodyZh: `save_course` 声明了 `expect`，会回读课程库。只有这条证据成立后，助手才应调用任务完成工具；完成动作只关闭目标，不写业务数据。

guide.note: Compare with Case 07. The page is identical. Case 06 adds one goal so the outcome survives closing the modal; Case 07 keeps only the three directives. Neither path adds a second form or a second execution channel.
guide.noteZh: 和案例07对照：页面完全相同。案例06多一个目标，让结果在弹窗关闭后仍然存在；案例07只保留三个指令。两条路径都不会增加第二张表单或第二条执行通道。
